z-m-33-01.title: Kana wapiwa mapoinzi matatu, poinzi yasara iri imwe chete here?
z-m-33-01.topic: Kuwana kona rasara rerutivi rweparallelogram kana makona matatu akapihwa
z-m-33-01.goal: Tonga kana kona rasara reparallelogram rakagadziriswa kuita poinzi imwe kana makona matatu chete aizivikanwa, taura kuti nei risina kugadziriswa uye ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera rwunodiwa (kurongwa kwemazita emakona), uye uwane iwe amene mapoinzi anogoneka.
z-m-33-01.material: Pacoordinate plane pane mapoinzi matatu A(0, 0), B(4, 1), C(5, 4). Maverengerwo: A i 'zero, zero', B i 'four, one', C i 'five, four'. Mapoinzi matatu aya haasi pamutsara mumwe. Unoda kusarudza poinzi D kuti mapoinzi mana A, B, C, D ave makona eparallelogram imwe. Dambudziko repakutanga rinoti chete 'rega kona rechina rive D', uye harina kutaura kuti makona akabatanidzwa nenzira ipi. Ma coordinates ose nhamba chaidzo, uye mapoinzi mana akasiyana pakati pawo.
z-m-33-01.thinking.1: Kupatsanura nyaya dzinogoneka nekudzitsvaga pasina kusiya
z-m-33-01.thinking.2: Kutsanangura kuti ruzivo rwekuwedzera runoderedza sei nhamba yenyaya
z-m-33-01.prereq.0: Kuisa mapoinzi pacoordinate plane nekuverenga rutivi nehuwandu hwekufamba pakati pemapoinzi maviri
z-m-33-01.prereq.1: Hunhu hweparallelogram (mativi akatarisana akaenzana uye parallel, ma diagonal anopatsanurana zvakaenzana) - ukuru hwechikoro chepakati
z-m-33-01.prereq.2: (Ibasa rakaiswa pa H2 nokuda kwekuita nyore kugadzira; rinoratidza nhanho yekuoma, kwete kuiswa kugiredhi. Rinofungidzirwa kudzidziswa shure kwe 'plane coordinates' muCommon Mathematics.)
z-m-33-01.s.s1.prompt: Nzvimbo yepoinzi D yakagadziriswa neruzivo rwuri pamusoro here? Sarudza kutonga kwakakodzera zvikuru.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.hint.0: Isa A, B, ne C pacoordinate plane uye uwedzere poinzi imwe kumatatu aya kuti ugadzire parallelogram.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.hint.1: Chinja kuti poinzi ipi yemapoinzi matatu iri yakatarisana ne D, isa D nguva imwe neimwe, uye uongorore nemaziso nguva imwe neimwe kana mativi akatarisana ari parallel.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.o.a: Yakagadziriswa kuita imwe. Mapoinzi matatu akagadziriswa, saka poinzi yekupedzisira iri imwe chete futi
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.a: Wakafungidzira kuti kana mapoinzi matatu akagadziriswa, zvasara zvakagadziriswa kuita chimwe. Rangarira kuti zita rechimiro chemativi mana (ABCD) rine kurongwa mukati mazvo.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.o.b: Haina kugadziriswa. Mativi anoda kuva parallel chete, saka pane asingaperi
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.b: Zvinoita sekuti wakaverenga mamiriro e parallel sepeya imwe chete. Parallelogram ine mapeya ose maviri emativi parallel, uye mamiriro maviri akawedzerwa anogadzirisa poinzi. Isa mapoinzi iwe amene kuti uongorore.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.o.c: Haina kugadziriswa. Inoenderana nokuti poinzi ipi inoitwa yakatarisana nepoinzi ipi
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.c: Wakacherekedza kuti D inochinja kana peya yakatarisana ichichinja. Kana ukaverengawo kuti pane mapeya mangani anogoneka, uchaona nhamba.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.d: Wakaona kuti pane D dzakawanda, asi zvinoita sekuti wakaverenga dzimwe chete. Pfuura nepoinzi yega yega yaigona kutarisana ne D, imwe panguva.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.explain: Zvichienderana nokuti poinzi ipi pakati pe A, B, C iri yakatarisana ne D, parallelogram inochinja, saka pane nzvimbo nhatu dzinogoneka dze D. Kana wapiwa ruzivo rwekuti mazita emakona akabatanidzwa nenzira (semuenzaniso, quadrilateral ABCD), mapeya akatarisana akagadziriswa uye D inoderedzwa kuita imwe. Saka ruzivo rwekuwedzera rwunodiwa mudambudziko iri ndiko kurongwa kwemakona.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.prompt: Wana uye uise mapoinzi 3 akasiyana D(x, y) anosangana nemamiriro. Zvakakwana kuti mapoinzi mana ave makona eparallelogram imwe nenzira ipi neipi. Mubhokisi riri pazasi, tanga wanyora ma coordinates emapoinzi chete, uye wobva wanyora zvikonzero.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza poinzi imwe yemapoinzi matatu uye uidaidze 'yakatarisana ne D', wobva wataridza kuti D yakabatana sei nesegment inobatanidza mapoinzi maviri asara.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.hint.1: Chinja poinzi yaunosarudza seyakatarisana nenzira A, B, C, uye uenzanise kana D dzinobuda dzakasiyana pakati padzo.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Iyi nzvimbo umo A, B, C, D dzinova makona eparallelogram imwe.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Nepoinzi D iyi, kubatanidza A, B, C, D nenzira ipi neipi hakugadzire parallelogram. Ongorora kana midpoints yemapoinzi maviri akatarisana yakafanana.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.explain: D dzinogoneka mapoinzi matatu (9, 5), (1, 3), (-1, -3). Inyaya umo D iri yakatarisana ne A, B, ne C nenzira, uye munyaya yega yega midpoints yemapoinzi maviri akatarisana iri panzvimbo imwe chete.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora kuti nei D isina kugadziriswa kuita imwe, uye zvaunofunga nezvekuti pangava nemamwe D anogoneka.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Maka poinzi yega yega yawakaisa kuti yakatarisana ne A, B, kana C ipi.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Verenga kuti mapoinzi mangani anogona kutarisana ne D.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ndakatsanangura here kuti nei D ichichinja se 'yakatarisana nepoinzi ipi'?
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ndakanyora here, kunyange mumutsara mumwe, chikonzero che 'pangava nemamwe here' (humbowo hwekuti ndakapatsanura nyaya dzose)?
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ndakasarudza here poinzi imwe yandakaisa ndokuongorora zvakare kana mativi ayo akatarisana ari parallel?
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.model.0: D inochinja zvichienderana nokuti mapoinzi maviri api aunotora semakona akatarisana. Kana yakatarisana ne A i (9, 5), kana yakatarisana ne B i (1, 3), uye kana yakatarisana ne C i (-1, -3). A, B, C chete ndidzo dzinogona kutarisana ne D, saka 3 ndizvo zvose zviripo.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Midpoints yema diagonal inofanira kuva imwe chete, saka kusarudza poinzi imwe yematatu seyakatarisana ne D kunopa D imwe imwe. Pane nzira 3 dzekusarudza, saka D ine nzvimbo 3, uye ndinofunga hapana dzimwe.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Kunyange kana usina kunyora ma coordinates, zvakakwana kana uine nhamba nechikonzero.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.prompt: Ruzivo rutsva rwasvika. Kana wakaongorora dambudziko zvakare, rakati 'parallelogram ABCD', uye makona akabatanidzwa nenzira A, B, C, D (A ne C dzakatarisana, B ne D dzakatarisana). D iri kupi zvino?
z-m-33-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kuti makona api ari padhuze ne D mu ABCD.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.hint.1: Sarudza poinzi uye uongorore iwe amene kana kufamba kubva kudivi AB kuenda kudivi DC kuine rutivi rwakafanana nehuwandu hwakafanana.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.a: Wakaiverenga seA ne D dzakatarisana. Munzira ABCD, mapeya akatarisana ndi A ne C, ne B ne D.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.b: Wakaiisa kuti B ne D dzitarisane. Ongorora kana mativi akatarisana AB ne DC ane rutivi rwakafanana nehurefu hwakafanana.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.c: Wakaiverenga seC ne D dzakatarisana. Munzira ABCD, vavakidzani veC ndi B ne D.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.o.d: Hazvisati zvaziviwa kuti ndeipi yenzvimbo nhatu
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.d: Wakasiya kuti kurongwa kunogadzirisa mapeya akatarisana. Kana kurongwa kwapihwa, nyora kuti poinzi ipi yakatarisana ne A uye ipi yakatarisana ne B.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.explain: Munzira ABCD, B ne D dzakatarisana, saka D = A + C - B, ndiko kuti (0+5-4, 0+4-1) = (1, 3). Ongorora: vector AB = (4, 1), uye vector DC = (5-1, 4-3) = (4, 1), iyo yakafanana. Ruzivo rutsva rwakaderedza kuita imwe yenzvimbo nhatu dzinogoneka.

z-m-33-02.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kutonga kwako nekuvimba kana ruzivo rutsva rwasvika
z-m-33-02.title: Kana mutsara ukabuda, madenderedzwa maviri anosangana here?
z-m-33-02.topic: Nzvimbo yemadenderedzwa maviri nemutsara unobuda kubva pama equation emadenderedzwa maviri
z-m-33-02.goal: Shandisa mienzaniso kuongorora kuti kunyange kana mutsara uchigara uchibuda kubva pama equation emadenderedzwa maviri, izvozvo oga hazvireve kuti madenderedzwa anosangana, uye uvake madenderedzwa maviri asingasangani iwe amene kuti utaure kuti chii chimwe chinofanira kuongororwa.
z-m-33-02.material: Equation yedenderedzwa C1 i x²+y²=4 (pakati (0, 0), radhiyasi 2). Maverengerwo: 'x squared plus y squared equals 4'. Denderedzwa C2 rine pakati (d, 0) neradhiyasi r, ne d>0, r>0. Equation yaro i (x-d)²+y²=r². Hayun akabvisa equation ye C2 kubva pa equation ye C1 divi nedivi kuwana expression yedhigirii rekutanga mu x, ndokuti, 'Mutsara wakabuda, saka madenderedzwa maviri anosangana pamapoinzi maviri apo mutsara uyu unopfuura.' Pano, madenderedzwa maviri 'anosangana' zvinoreva kuti pane poinzi iri pamadenderedzwa ose maviri (kusanganisira nyaya yekubatana).
z-m-33-02.thinking.0: Kusiyanisa mamiriro umo chirevo chinoshanda kubva mumienzaniso umo chisingashande
z-m-33-02.thinking.2: Kuvaka iwe amene mienzaniso inopokana nekuiparadzanisa kuita marudzi
z-m-33-02.prereq.0: Revo ye equation yedenderedzwa (x-a)²+(y-b)²=r² nekuverenga pakati neradhiyasi
z-m-33-02.prereq.1: Revo yenzvimbo dzemadenderedzwa maviri (akaparadzana, anobatana, anosangana pamapoinzi maviri, rimwe riri mukati merimwe)
z-m-33-02.prereq.2: (Ibasa rakaiswa pa H2 nokuda kwekuita nyore kugadzira; rinoratidza nhanho yekuoma, kwete kuiswa kugiredhi. Rinofungidzirwa kuuya shure kwekudzidza equation yedenderedzwa muCommon Mathematics.)
z-m-33-02.s.s1.prompt: Data ichabuda imwe panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, tonga kuti madenderedzwa maviri anosangana pamapoinzi mangani, uye ufunge kuti unogona kuvimba nechirevo chaHayun kusvika kupi.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.hint.0: Isa ma coordinates epoinzi iri pamutsara zvakananga mu equation ye C1 kuti uongorore kana chaizvoizvo inoigutsawo.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kana d ne r dzichichinja, enzanisa chinhambwe pakati pemapakati maviri nehuwandu hweradhiyasi.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Kubvisa ma equation e C1 ne C2 kunopa 2dx = d² + 4 - r², saka chero bedzi d isiri 0, unowana mutsara umo x ikukosha kumwe chete. Makosha e d ne r haasati azivikanwa.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unogona kutaura here kuti 'madenderedzwa maviri anosangana' kubva pachokwadi chekuti mutsara wakabuda chete?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Mutsara kubuda ruzivo rwekuti 'kana pane mapoinzi ekusangana, ari pamutsara uyu'. Chivimbiso chekuti pane mapoinzi ekusangana chinofanira kuongororwa zvakaparadzana. Ngativaedze nedata inotevera.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Unogona kutaura. Poinzi yose yakafanana yemadenderedzwa maviri iri pamutsara uyu
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Zvinoita sekuti wakaverenga 'kana pane poinzi yakafanana, iri pamutsara' se 'pane poinzi yakafanana'. Chirevo chekutanga chinotaura nezvekuti poinzi inovapo rinhi.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Haugone kutaura. Zvose zvaunogona kuziva ndezvekuti kana pane mapoinzi ekusangana, ari pamutsara uyu
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Haugone kutaura. Mutsara kubuda chaizvoizvo kunoreva kuti madenderedzwa maviri haasangani
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakaverenga chokwadi chekuti mutsara wakabuda sehumbowo hwerutivi rwakapesana. Funga kana mutsara unobudawo kumadenderedzwa maviri anosangana.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kana usingazivi makosha e d ne r, mutsara uyu hauna chauri kukuudza
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Usina makosha, haugone kuziva kana pane mapoinzi ekusangana, asi unogona kutaura kuti ari kupi kana aripo. Ongorora kana mutsara uyu chaizvoizvo usingapi ruzivo.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Zvakagadziriswa kuti d = 6, r = 1. Kubvisa ma equation kunopa 12x = 39, ndiko kuti mutsara x = 13/4 = 3.25. Kuti poinzi iri pamutsara uyu iri pa C1 futi, unoda y² = 4 - (13/4)² = -105/16 (y i nhamba chaiyo).
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.after: y² yakaipa, saka hapana poinzi ye C1 iri pamutsara uyu. Izvi zvinoenderanawo nechokwadi chekuti chinhambwe che6 pakati pemapakati makuru kupfuura huwandu hweradhiyasi, 3, saka madenderedzwa akaparadzana. Mutsara wakabuda, asi madenderedzwa maviri haasangani. Chokwadi chekuti mutsara unogara uchibuda hachisi humbowo hwemapoinzi ekusangana.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Mapoinzi 2. Sezvakataura Hayun, mutsara wakabuda, saka anosangana pamapoinzi maviri
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Unoramba uchigamuchira mutsara kubuda sehumbowo hwemapoinzi ekusangana. Tarisa kana chaizvoizvo pane poinzi ye C1 iri pamutsara uyu.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Poinzi 1. Mutsara ne C1 zvinosangana papoinzi imwe
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakafunga nyaya umo mutsara nedenderedzwa zvinosangana, asi zvinoita sekuti hauna kuongorora chiratidzo che y². Kana y² yakaipa, pane y chaiyo here?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Mapoinzi 0. Hapana poinzi ye C1 iri pamutsara
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakatonga zvichibva pamugumisiro wekuenzanisa mapoinzi ari pamutsara ne equation ye C1.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Wakachinja kuita d = 3, r = 2. Kubvisa ma equation kunopa 6x = 9, ndiko kuti mutsara x = 3/2. Kuuisa mu C1 kunopa y² = 4 - 9/4 = 7/4.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Panguva ino, madenderedzwa maviri anosangana pamapoinzi mangani?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.after: y = ±√7/2 (anenge ±1.32), saka anosangana pamapoinzi maviri (3/2, ±√7/2). Zvinoshandawo kudivi re C2: (3/2 - 3)² + 7/4 = 4. Munyaya iyi mhedziso yaHayun yakanga yakarurama. Chinosarudza kuti anosangana here hachisi chokwadi chekuti mutsara wakabuda, asi kuti pane mapoinzi e C1 pamutsara iwoyo here.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Mapoinzi 2. y inotora makosha maviri, akanaka neakaipa, saka pane mapoinzi maviri
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakaverenga kuti y inotora makosha maviri kubva pa y² = 7/4.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Mapoinzi 0. Kunyange mutsara wakabuda, sapakare, haasangani
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakashandisa muenzaniso wapakare sezvawakanga wakaita kune uyu. Enzanisa kana chiratidzo che y² panguva ino chakafanana nechepakutanga.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Poinzi 1. Pane poinzi imwe chete ye C1 iri pamutsara
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Poinzi 1. Pane poinzi imwe chete ye C1 iri pamutsara
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Verenga kuti y mbiri dzinobva pakukosha kumwe che y². Kana y² yakanaka, pane y dzingani?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.info: Wakachinja kuita d = 4, r = 2. Kubvisa ma equation kunopa 8x = 16, ndiko kuti mutsara x = 2. Kuuisa mu C1 kunopa y² = 4 - 4 = 0.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.after: Pane y = 0 chete, saka anobatana papoinzi imwe (2, 0). Iyi inyaya umo chinhambwe che4 pakati pemapakati anoenzana nehuwandu hweradhiyasi 2+2. Munyaya iyi mutsara x = 2 itangent yakafanana yemadenderedzwa maviri. Kunyange kana mutsara wabuda, nhamba yemapoinzi ekusangana inogona kuva 0, 1, kana 2.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Mapoinzi 0. Mutsara wakabuda, asi hausangani ne C1
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Pamwe wakaverenga y² = 0 se 'hapana mhinduro'. Ongorora kana pane y chaiyo inogutsa y² = 0.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Wakaona kuti kana y² = 0, pane y imwe chete.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.o.c: Mapoinzi 2. Sepanhanho yapfuura, mutsara unopfuura nemapoinzi maviri
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Wakatakura mugumisiro wedanho rapfuura sezvawakanga wakaita. Enzanisa kuti y dzingani dzinobva pakukosha kwe y² panguva ino nedzakabuda pakutanga.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.reflect: Kuvimba kwako nezve chokwadi chekuti mutsara wakabuda kwakachinja sei sezvawaipfuura nemienzaniso? Chii chakasiyana pakati penyaya umo chirevo chaHayun chakarurama nenyaya umo chakanga chisina kururama? Chii chaunofanira kuongorora nguva dzose mushure mekunge mutsara wabuda?
z-m-33-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira iwe amene mienzaniso umo chirevo chaHayun chisina kururama. Sarudza pakati (d, 0) neradhiyasi r ye C2 uye uise marudzi 2 akasiyana enyaya umo madenderedzwa maviri asingasangani. Rega muenzaniso mumwe uve umo madenderedzwa maviri akaparadzana kunze kwerimwe nerimwe, uye mumwe umo denderedzwa rimwe riri mukati merimwe saka asingasangani.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa radhiyasi 2 ye C1 ne r uye ufunge kuti chinhambwe d pakati pemapakati anofanira kuva makuru sei kuti aparadzane.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kuti uise denderedzwa rimwe mukati merimwe, edza kusarudza d uchiriyenzanisa nemusiyano weradhiyasi.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.hint.2: Mushure mekusarudza vanokwanisika, ivaenzanise nemuenzaniso wawakaona pakutanga, sa d = 6, r = 1, uye uongorore kuti vakafanana rudzi.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.var.d: Koodhineti ye x d yepakati pe C2
z-m-33-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Zvose d ne r dzinofanira kuva dzakakura kupfuura 0.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Madenderedzwa maviri aya anosangana kana kubata. Inofanira kuva muenzaniso umo asingasangani. Enzanisa chinhambwe chiri pakati pezvikamu zvepakati nema radius.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.explain: Muenzaniso: (d, r) = (5, 1) ine chinhambwe chiri pakati pezvikamu zvepakati 5, chakakura kupfuura huwandu hwema radius 3, saka akaparadzana kunze, uye (1, 5) ine C2 ichipinza C1, saka haasangani (radius ye C1 i 2, uye chinhambwe chepakati 1 chiri pasi pomusiyano wema radius maviri, 3). Mumamiriro ose maviri d > 0, saka mutsetse unobuda, asi madenderedzwa maviri haasangani. Mamiriro okubata kubva mukati (semuenzaniso, d = 2, r = 4) anosangana papoinzi rimwe, saka haaverengwi.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.prompt: Udza Hayun: kana ukabvisa zvirevo uchiwana mutsetse, chii chimwe chinofanira kutarisirwa usati wataura kuti 'madenderedzwa maviri anosangana', uye sei? Nyora.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mumutsetse mumwe kuti sei, mumuenzaniso d = 6, r = 1, asina kusangana kunyange mutsetse wakabuda.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.hint.1: Rangarira kuti wakaziva sei nokuverenga kana kuenzanisa kupi mumuenzaniso iwoyo kuti asingasangani.
